common.description: Package tracker card for tracking parcels
common.name: Package tracker card
common.no_packages: No packages to track at the moment

editor.entity_helper: The accounts whose packages are shown. Packages from several are listed together.
editor.title: Title
editor.statuses_helper: Only packages with one of these statuses are listed. With none chosen, all of them are.
editor.direction_helper: Incoming packages, sent ones, or both. When the card shows both, each package has a marker that says which way it goes. A package whose direction the integration doesn't give is incoming.
editor.height_helper: A fixed height in pixels. Leave the field empty and the card's height follows the number of packages.
editor.max_height_helper: A height the card never grows past. Leave the field empty and the card's height has no limit.
editor.show_destination_helper: Where the package is going — the pickup point when the carrier names one.
editor.show_pickup_helper: Adds the pickup deadline to that row, or the estimated delivery while the package is still on its way.
editor.show_details_helper: The package's weight and how many parcels it has.
editor.wrap_text_helper: When this is off, overlong texts are cut short instead of wrapping.
editor.pickup_code_helper: The code the package can be picked up with. It must be turned on in the integration's settings too.
editor.tracking_link_helper: A click on what opens the official package tracking page.
